info.name: BigCommerce Abandoned Cart Emails Price Lists Records API
BigCommerce Create Batch of Price Lists Records

items.docs: Creates a batch of `Price Lists Records`; may include price list records from more than one price list.  Concurrency limit of 1.

info.name: BigCommerce Get All Price List Records

params.name: price_list_id
params.description: The ID of the `Price List` requested.

params.name: variant_id:in
params.description: The ID of the `Variant` for which prices were requested.

params.name: product_id:in
params.description: A comma-separated list of IDs of `Product`s for which prices were requested.

params.name: currency
params.description: Filter items by currency.

params.name: page
params.description: Specifies the page number in a limited (paginated) list of products.

params.name: limit
params.description: Controls the number of items per page in a limited (paginated) list of products.

params.name: include
params.description: Sub-resources to include on a price record, in a comma-separated list. Valid expansions currently include `bulk_pricing_tiers` and `sku`. Other values will be ignored.

params.name: price
params.description: Filter items by price.

params.name: sale_price
params.description: Filter items by sale_price.

params.name: retail_price
params.description: Filter items by retail_price.

params.name: map_price
params.description: Filter items by map_price.

params.name: calculated_price
params.description: Filter items by calculated_price.

params.name: date_created
params.description: Filter items by date_created.

params.name: date_modified
params.description: Filter items by date_modified. For example `v3/catalog/products?date_last_imported:min=2022-06-15`

params.name: sku
params.description: Filter items by SKU.

items.docs:
Returns a list of *Price List Records* associated with a *Price List*.

**Notes**
* Supports up to 10 simultaneous GET requests. Running more than the allowed number of requests concurrently on the same store will result in a `429` status error and your additional requests will fail.
* Store Pricelist Records data to reduce the number of calls and maximize performance.

params.name: price_list_id
params.description: The ID of the `Price List` requested.

items.docs:
Creates or updates *Price List Records*. 

**Required Fields**
* currency

**Notes**
* Batch requests support up to 1,000 items per request.
* Up to 2 concurrent batch upsert requests are supported with this API. Running more than the allowed concurrent requests in parallel on the **same store** will cause a `429` error, and your additional requests will fail. info.name: BigCommerce Delete a Price List Record

params.name: price_list_id
params.description: The ID of the `Price List` requested.

params.name: variant_id:in
params.description: The ID of the `Variant` for which prices were requested.

items.docs: Deletes a *Price List Record*. Deleting the records does not delete the Price List. Optional parameters can be passed in.

info.name: BigCommerce Get Price Records by Variant

params.name: price_list_id
params.description: The ID of the `Price List` requested.

params.name: variant_id
params.description: ID of the variant on a product, or on an associated Price List Record.

items.docs:
Returns *Price List Records* using the variant ID. Will also contain currency records.

**Notes**
* Supports up to 40 simultaneous GET requests. Running more than the allowed number of requests concurrently on the same store will result in a `429` status error, and your additional requests will fail.
* Store Pricelist Records data to reduce the number of calls and maximize performance.

info.name: BigCommerce Get a Price Record by Currency Code

params.name: price_list_id
params.description: The ID of the `Price List` requested.

params.name: variant_id
params.description: ID of the variant on a product, or on an associated Price List Record.

params.name: currency_code
params.description: The currency code associated with the price record being acted upon.

params.name: include
params.description: Sub-resources to include on a price record, in a comma-separated list. Valid expansions currently include `bulk_pricing_tiers` and `sku`. Other values will be ignored.

items.docs:
Returns a *Price List Record* using the currency code. You can use optional parameters.
**Notes**
* Supports up to 50 simultaneous GET requests. Running more than the allowed number of requests concurrently on the same store will result in a `429` status error, and your additional requests will fail.

info.name: BigCommerce Set Price List Record by Currency Code

params.name: price_list_id
params.description: The ID of the `Price List` requested.

params.name: variant_id
params.description: ID of the variant on a product, or on an associated Price List Record.

params.name: currency_code
params.description: The currency code associated with the price record being acted upon.

items.docs:
Creates or updates a *Price List Record* using the currency code.
**Notes**
* Supports up to 40 simultaneous PUT requests. Running more than the allowed number of requests concurrently on the same store will result in a `429` status error, and your additional requests will fail.

info.name: BigCommerce Delete a Price Record by Currency Code

params.name: price_list_id
params.description: The ID of the `Price List` requested.

params.name: variant_id
params.description: ID of the variant on a product, or on an associated Price List Record.

params.name: currency_code
params.description: The currency code associated with the price record being acted upon.

items.docs:
Deletes a *Price List Record* using the currency code.
**Note:**
* Supports up to 25 simultaneous DELETE requests. Running more than the allowed number of requests concurrently on the same store will result in a `429` status error, and your additional requests will fail.
